input.sql: SELECT SUM(credit) AS v FROM fact_gl_entry JOIN dim_account ON fact_gl_entry.account_id = dim_account.account_id WHERE fact_gl_entry.is_deleted = 0 AND fact_gl_entry.currency = 'CNY' AND dim_account.account_type = '收入' AND fact_gl_entry.period LIKE '2025%'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN dim_account.account_type = '收入' THEN credit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN dim_account.account_type = '成本' THEN debit ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN dim_account.account_type = '收入' THEN credit ELSE 0 END) AS v FROM fact_gl_entry JOIN dim_account ON fact_gl_entry.account_id = dim_account.account_id WHERE fact_gl_entry.is_deleted = 0 AND fact_gl_entry.currency = 'CNY' AND fact_gl_entry.period LIKE '2025%'
